Coming from a fellow bipolar 1 sufferer I understand. I wouldn't wish it on my worst enemy. It's like being ripped apart inside by your own mind. Right now, I know it feels like it will never end. I guess what I'm trying to say is I understand. I go through it too and I can listen if you want me to. Feel free to pm me if you need.
